children: Tesla cut Hong Kong Model 3 entry to HK$205,000 (~$26k), an ~8.5% drop; Macau Model 3 now 252,000 patacas (~$31k). TSLA U.S. shares rose ~3% after the announcement.

Tesla (TSLA) is expanding its robo-taxi rollout since June 2025. Traders watch Full Self-Driving progress, targeting a major v15 milestone expected in late 2026–early 2027.
Analysts keep a Buy consensus on Tesla (TSLA) with a 12‑month average price target near $390; some rate it Hold or Sell amid debate over autonomous driving profitability and margins.
Tesla (TSLA) deployed occupant-free Cybercabs in Austin, lacking steering wheels and pedals; downtown activity rose and Elon Musk said he may expand the fleet, drawing public reactions.
Tesla (TSLA) France registrations surged 278.5% in August year-over-year; overall French new car registrations rose 7.4% for the month.
